content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect alignment issues in the struct siginfo due to the relocation of addr_lsb into the _sigfault union. Specifically, the size and alignment of the _sigfault union were not properly accounted for, which led to misalignment of the si_pkey member. This misalignment occurred because the pointers involved required pointer alignment for the entire union, necessitating the change of dummy fields (_dummy_pkey and _dummy_bnd) to pointer types (compat_uptr_t) to ensure correct alignment and prevent potential memory access violations or incorrect data interpretation.
